name: Hierarchical Binary-Scene Voxelization
definition: A robust scene voxelization and octree construction method that computes a multi-resolution binary volumetric representation in a few milliseconds on the GPU, suitable for fully dynamic scenes.
summary: Hierarchical Binary-Scene Voxelization is a real-time GPU method that rasterizes geometry from three orthogonal directions and unions the results to eliminate boundary holes in dynamic scenes.
